scope: Global actual-ultrasound media and license-context audit for Stage 1-10.

policy.embedded_asset_rule: A locally reused ultrasound image/video must retain explicit source_page, author, and license metadata.
policy.link_only_rule: A canonical publication/figure may be linked without local copying. When exact reuse rights are not relied upon, the audit records source_context_only_no_local_copy rather than inferring a license.
policy.derivative_rule: Do not modify figures marked ND; preserve article/figure context when license or clinical labeling matters.
